description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different model and language family combinations. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. For each language family, there are six bars representing different models: “mBERT-L2” (light green), “XLM-L2” (medium green), “mBERT-R2” (light red), “XLM-R2” (medium red), “mBERT-B2” (light brown), and “XLM-B2” (medium brown). Each bar is accompanied by an error bar indicating variability. The bars are grouped by language family, with each model represented by a bar within that group. The shortest bars are generally found for the “Isolate” language family, with “XLM-B2” reaching approximately 1.5, while the tallest bars are found for the “Semitic” language family, with “mBERT-L2” reaching approximately 27. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
